description: Promote / demote a member. Roles: owner(100) > superadmin(90) > admin(80) > moderator(70) > member(10). No 'guest'. An actor may assign any role below their own tier — so a superadmin (not only the owner) can promote to admin.

identity_id.description: Target user's identity id (UUID). From mDM_list_contacts or radar logs.

role.description: Role to assign. owner = channel creator (not assignable); promote up to one tier below your own.

name: mIRC_set_role
